question:
Study the given graph and answer the question that follows.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd0c09452490048ac68f0a2e45ab07953eafc05496822bc9db7cf7c1c9dafaba.png] 

In which year are the exports of the country 87.5% of the average imports during 2016, 2017 and 2018 ?
solution:
**Calculation:**

The average imports during 2016, 2017 and 2018 = (420 + 450 + 330)/2

⇒ 1200/3

⇒ 400

Now,

The exports of the country in 2014 to the average imports during 2016, 2017 and 2018 = (440/400 × 100)

⇒ 110%

Which is not equal to the exports of the country 87.5%

Now,

The exports of the country in 2015 to the average imports during 2016, 2017 and 2018 = (350/400 × 100)

⇒ 87.5%

It is equal to the the exports of the country 87.5%

Now,

The exports of the country in 2016 to the average imports during 2016, 2017 and 2018 = (370/400 × 100)

⇒ 92.5%

Which is not equal to the exports of the country 87.5%

The exports of the country in 2017 to the average imports during 2016, 2017 and 2018 = (360/400 × 100)

⇒ 90%

Which is not equal to the exports of the country 87.5%

The exports of the country in 2017 to the average imports during 2016, 2017 and 2018 = (450/400 × 100)

⇒ 112.5%

Which is not equal to the exports of the country 87.5%

**∴ The exports of the country 87.5% of the average imports during 2016, 2017 and 2018 in the year 2015**
